snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Halting Station Preview Video
snippet.description:
Time-Limited Event [Halting Station] will be open from 2/6.
During the event, Commanders can receive generous rewards including [Collapse Pieces], [Targeted Access Permissions], [Basic Info Cores] by clearing event stages and participating in the event Game mode.

[Duration] 
2025/2/6 09:00 - 2025/2/26 18:59(GMT+0)
The event shop exchange will expire at 3/5 18:59 (GMT+0).

[Unlock Conditions] 
Commander Level 20
